title: Prompt Vault — Debugging Guide
purpose: Quick triage reference for diagnosing and fixing common issues in Prompt Vault.
triage_order: 1. UI/rendering issue → check pages/ and components/
2. Data not loading → check useQuery key, route constant, and server/routes.ts handler
3. Schema mismatch → check shared/schema.ts, run npm run db:push
5. AI not responding → check server/ai-provider.ts and provider config in localStorage
6. MCP tools missing → check server/mcp-client.ts and server URL validity
7. Vault not syncing → check use-vault.ts and browser (must be Chrome or Edge)

common_issues.likely_cause: TanStack Query cache not invalidated after mutation
common_issues.fix: Ensure useMutation onSuccess calls queryClient.invalidateQueries with the correct key (e.g. ['/api/prompts'])

common_issues.likely_cause: Zod validation failure on request body
common_issues.fix: Log the request body and compare it against the Zod schema in shared/schema.ts. Check for missing required fields or wrong types.

common_issues.symptom: DB column does not exist error
common_issues.likely_cause: Schema was updated in shared/schema.ts but DB was not migrated

common_issues.symptom: Vault folder button does nothing or permission denied
common_issues.likely_cause: Not using Chrome or Edge, or permission was revoked
common_issues.fix: Use Chrome or Edge. If permission was revoked, the user must click to re-grant access.

common_issues.symptom: Vault handle persists but no sync
common_issues.likely_cause: IndexedDB handle exists but permission query returns 'prompt'
common_issues.fix: Check use-vault.ts — the hook re-requests permission on load. If denied, clears the handle and prompts user to re-select.

common_issues.likely_cause: window.__setDraggingPromptId not being set or read correctly
common_issues.fix: Check prompt-card.tsx onDragStart sets the global, and layout.tsx collection drop zone reads it.

common_issues.symptom: AI chat returns nothing or errors
common_issues.likely_cause: Provider not configured, missing API key, or Ollama not running
common_issues.fix: Check localStorage for provider/model settings. For Ollama, verify it's running locally on port 11434. For cloud providers, verify key is set.

common_issues.likely_cause: File picker filtered to .md only; user may have navigated to wrong folder
common_issues.fix: Confirm the folder contains .md files. Check import-modal.tsx file picker accept attribute.

common_issues.likely_cause: Server URL is wrong or server is not running
common_issues.fix: Check the MCP server URL in mcp-manager.tsx. Test the URL directly to confirm the server responds.

common_issues.symptom: Frontend shows wrong data after edit
common_issues.fix: Check that the relevant query key is being invalidated after the mutation in the useMutation onSuccess callback.

useful_commands.check_logs: View the workflow console in the Replit interface
useful_commands.check_db: Use the database skill or psql via DATABASE_URL env var

never_do: Do not modify vite.ts or vite.config.ts unless absolutely necessary
Do not add business logic to route handlers in server/routes.ts
Do not query the database directly from routes — use server/storage.ts
Do not hardcode API route strings — always use shared/routes.ts constants
Do not persist AI chat messages to the database
